test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2dc9544576d9f8f27a601addafba2f58712ff1ac1248a3726368e793a0b95ce2.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series is:

**From Figure (1) to (2):**

The shapes are moving as shown below and the upper shape (Circle) changes into the other shape (Triangle).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/661aa4b4504299a2f2036977360a23c56daa76b867367ab93dc1199b614d49a9.png] 

**From Figure (2) to (3):**

The shapes are moving as shown below and the upper shape (Rectangle) changes into the other shape (Y).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f29a8a19cd97a6e0b0d9d93d14e1a08049dad53eeb4822fb8088e83328d8f23.png] 

**From Figure (3) to (4):**

The shapes are moving as shown below and the upper shape changes into the other shape.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b611e3c549f455de14e4aa325650b0b348f10c5b26d4a40a0a8b6cd870212f95.png] 

**From Figure (4) to Answer Figure:**

The shapes are moving as shown below and the upper shape (Triangle) changes into the other shape.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1f754aed70307ef6b5e0f5896a34101e39acf887a2daa47d4112a499e13f666.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option (4)".**
